question.text: The tangents at the extremities of the latus rectum of the ellipse <math><mn>3</mn><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>12</mn></math> form a rhombus <math><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">Q</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></math>. Area (in sq. units) of the rhombus <math><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">Q</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi></math> outside the ellipse is equal to

solution.text:
One of the end of latus rectum is 1,32
Tangent at 1,32 is x+2y=4
Area of rhombus =412⋅4⋅2=16

Hence, the required area =16-23π sq. units
